# Transcript chapter template

Use this template only after source processing is authorized. Replace prompts
with evidence; leave unknowns explicit. Do not treat the template as a chapter.

## Source and review state

- Title and chapter ID:
- Source recording ID and hash:
- Source-relative interval, start inclusive and end exclusive:
- Input part/checkpoint identities and contributing intervals:
- Artifact type: nonverbatim edited conversation unless otherwise verified.
- Review state, processing authorization, and reviewer evidence:
- Timing precision, redactions, omissions, and coverage limitations:

## Participants and bots

Record stable human and bot instance IDs, aliases, owners, roles, addressees,
attribution status, and the evidence supporting each attribution. Distinguish
an audible human reader from the bot credited with the output being read.

## Orientation

Summarize the topic briefly. This section does not replace the conversation.

## Edited conversation

Use timestamped topic subsections and preserve the substantive conversation.
For each turn or inseparable group, record speaker, addressee, interaction type,
probable/confirmed/unresolved attribution, and readable nonverbatim content.
Retain corrections and disagreements. Mark mixed speech instead of fabricating
clean speaker turns. Avoid quotation marks for text checked only against ASR.

## Editorial changes and unresolved evidence

Log consequential name/number/meaning changes with source intervals and review
basis. Account for excluded gaps and inaudibility. Add explicit audio-check
results for consequential claims; do not turn an unperformed check into a pass.

## Handoff to synthesis

List evidence-backed candidate decisions, requested/reported/demonstrated actions,
lessons, and unanswered questions. These remain candidates until reviewed.
